ننسطل (form VII)
# نَنْسَطِلُ (nansaṭilu) /nan.sa.tˤi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْسَطَلَ (insaṭala)
# نَنْسَطِلَ (nansaṭila) /nan.sa.tˤi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَطَلَ (insaṭala)
# نَنْسَطِلْ (nansaṭil) /nan.sa.tˤil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْسَطَلَ (insaṭala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
